g.text: Scale tier — failure modes, cost and when to graduate
PRODUCTION SCALE TIER · interview design, not built · documented = explained with priced mitigations. Costs are projections; demo and 1K rows run on the deployed demo tier (ADR-0015).
US profile, then breaker → Foundry, same models
run cold; static limits; streams poll Postgres
lease expiry → next attempt; fenced commit
collect the rest; no fabricated memo
admission 429 + Retry-After before the queue grows
accept 503 ≈ 30 s; leases protect running jobs
Cloudflare status page; nothing else runs
COST SHARE BY TIER (projection, per month)
DT = demo-tier services (1K: quotas and cap lifted); 100K+ on the scale tier. Below ~1K
users search awake time dominates; above it, tokens do. * rerank only if Gate C adopts it
DEMO → SCALE TIER · move a component only when its trigger is measured
near Workers free limits or latency SLO
read cost > Valkey or sub-ms limits
named users or a paid plan
cap hit on ≥ 3 days a week
DEPLOY ON TAG · eval-gated, then canary on SLOs
frozen evidence, paired tolerance vs the active approved baseline
ECS blue/green; automatic rollback when the canary burns error budget
MIGRATION SEAMS · each move is an adapter swap behind a protocol
RunStore: DynamoDB → Postgres (dual-write, diff 0 for 7 days)
JobQueue: SQS via stream → SQS via outbox
runtime: Lambda handler → ECS service, same image
every move is shadowed, compared, then cut over
test-plan §20 suite passes on the new adapter
